summary.zh: 为 React 应用补测试与端到端用例
summary.en: Write Jest, RTL and Playwright tests for React apps

description.zh: 为 React 与 Next.js 项目编写单元测试、组件测试和 Playwright 端到端流程，用 MSW 模拟接口。适合给某个组件或页面补测试、搭 E2E 流程、找出覆盖率缺口时使用。
description.en: Writes Jest and React Testing Library tests, mocks APIs with MSW, and builds Playwright end-to-end suites for React and Next.js apps. Use it to cover a component or page, add E2E flows, or close coverage gaps.
